subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a multi-turn session model lease for `/model --turns N`, and should that contract be unified with the one-turn model override work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100876?
rationale: The request changes model routing semantics, persisted session state, command UX, Gateway API shape, and config defaults; the correct contract and compatibility behavior are product/API choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract first
options.body: Create or update the canonical design so one-turn and N-turn model overrides share session-state, provider/auth validation, revert, warning, docs, and upgrade semantics before code is queued.

options.title: Limit scope to one-turn override
options.body: Keep this issue open or close it later only if maintainers intentionally decide to support one-shot model overrides but not N-turn leases or configured turn limits.

options.title: Preserve sticky model selection only
options.body: Reject temporary model leases and keep users on `/model default` plus existing persistent session selection behavior.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract first
recommendation.body: Create or update the canonical design so one-turn and N-turn model overrides share session-state, provider/auth validation, revert, warning, docs, and upgrade semantics before code is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the session patch, Gateway protocol, and session management surfaces that would own the contract decision.
